snippet.title: V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls - Official Gameplay Trailer| The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls, a souls roguelike developed by Tripearl Games. Players will experience the conflict between V.E.D.A, an AI supercomputer created to help humanity survive climate change and pandemics, and a hacker group called 'Daybreak Destroyers'. through a deep narrative about human evolution and survival. Don't miss the latest trailer showing off new boss encounters, boss battles, gameplay features, and more. V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls is launching in 2026 for PC (Steam) with a demo launching in August 2025 on Steam.
